notes.title: Avatar system and the new war system！
notes.content:
Amenders:

The second free DLC 'Stars Will' for 'Lightracer Spark' released on Nov 16th.

In order to provide you with a better gaming experience, the DLC2 "Stars Will", the English version will be postponed to January 2024. Because we are a Chinese Dev team, we will give priority to using Chinese during development, and then ask a professional localization team to process it into English. The localization work for DLC2 was more complicated than expected, so we had to postpone the release of the English version. We will make full use of this time to polish copywriting translation and UI adaptation. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you. thank you for your support!

But you can now play the following content:

We have reworked the combat system and added a new "AVATAR" system, hoping to make the combat experience more in line with the amenders' expectations.

[h3]Introduction to the avatar system[/h3]
Play as the Amender, descending directly into the world in the form of an avatar, issuing instructions to destroy the enemy or strengthen your own army and jurisdiction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2a0d164012fa6d6facde5d8c35ec030526fb484d.png[/img]

[h3]War system remake[/h3]
The version replaces the previous war system, hoping to reduce cumbersome operations and change the overall game experience.
The new version of the war system focuses on the operation of avatars and special troops. The operation methods of the above two are similar to the old version, but they can move forward to any jurisdiction on the same planet without restrictions.
The conventional army will be modified to a control method in the form of issuing orders. You no longer need to directly control each army. Instead, you can assemble the army after choosing a war strategy. The conventional army will complete the combat mission according to your deployment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/4737974cec97b9784479fd4a907da274841ff574.png[/img]

Four types and more than 30 avatar commands
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/79d56e876f26207906c4d7f6daf21563f6ad3bfd.png[/img]

Three different avatar forms
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2643f3697f5b28fda114f93ddad4d39f219adc7b.png[/img]

Your avatar can be born from the prologue, so the story of Tien has changed slightly.
Avatars have level settings. After investing basic resources, you can upgrade the level and unlock exclusive instructions for the current form.
Most commands can be upgraded to improve their effectiveness, but require special resources from the warehouse.

To celebrate the release of the new version, the game has launched a limited-time discount this week, interested amenders should not miss it!

notes.title: Join our BETA testing to experience avatar system and the new war system
notes.content:
Amenders:

We have received a lot of feedback since the release of Lightracer Spark, and we would like to sincerely thank you all. Many of them are discussions about the combat system, believing that the current combat operations are too cumbersome and inconsistent with the perspective of advanced civilization. To this end, we have reworked the combat system and added a new "AVATAR" system, hoping to make the combat experience more in line with the amenders' expectations.

At present, this content has been initially developed. Next, we want to work with the amenders to make the new version of the combat experience more perfect. So we plan to start beta testing before the official version is updated. Beta testing is open to everyone, and interested amenders can switch to the corresponding branch to experience it. There will inevitably be experience deficiencies or bugs in the Beta test version. We would like to apologize to you in advance, and please fully understand this possibility before switching branches to experience it.

[h2]Note[/h2]
1. Participating players must own the Lightracer Spark to enter the test branch.
2. The archives of the test branch is independent from the archives of the main game and do not interfere with each other. That is to say, the test branch needs to play the game from the beginning. Therefore, after you switch back to the main game branch, the game progress of the previous main game will be saved and will not be affected.

[h2]How to enter test branch[/h2]
Right-click Lightracer Spark in the library → click Properties → click Betas → enter the test branch code [i][b]zhuguangBeta[/b][/i] in the private betas column → click Check Code to enter the branch and the game will automatically update → enter the game after the update is completed.

[h2]Introduction to the avatar system[/h2]
Play as the Amender, descending directly into the world in the form of an avatar, issuing instructions to destroy the enemy or strengthen your own army and jurisdiction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2a0d164012fa6d6facde5d8c35ec030526fb484d.png[/img]

[h2]War system remake[/h2]
The Beta version replaces the previous war system, hoping to reduce cumbersome operations and change the overall game experience.
The new version of the war system focuses on the operation of avatars and special troops. The operation methods of the above two are similar to the old version, but they can move forward to any jurisdiction on the same planet without restrictions.
The conventional army will be modified to a control method in the form of issuing orders. You no longer need to directly control each army. Instead, you can assemble the army after choosing a war strategy. The conventional army will complete the combat mission according to your deployment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/4737974cec97b9784479fd4a907da274841ff574.png[/img]
Four types and more than 30 avatar commands
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/79d56e876f26207906c4d7f6daf21563f6ad3bfd.png[/img]
Three different avatar forms
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2643f3697f5b28fda114f93ddad4d39f219adc7b.png[/img]
Your avatar can be born from the prologue, so the story of Tien has changed slightly.
Avatars have level settings. After investing basic resources, you can upgrade the level and unlock exclusive instructions for the current form.
Most commands can be upgraded to improve their effectiveness, but require special resources from the warehouse.

[h2]Attention[/h2]
[list]
[*] The test is open to everyone from now on and is expected to end before the release of DLC2
[*] Please do not copy and overwrite the BETA test archives to the main game archive directory!
[*] When the official version has the avatar system, some content may be adjusted.
[*] Tell us what you think. You can let us know your feedback or suggestions through the following methods
[/list]
Feedback link：https://www.wjx.top/vm/eBmqN8E.aspx#
Official Discord：https://discord.gg/SzvGbBcKuC     DM our staff
The "Bug report" button in the game menu 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/518d12932d9033258b7b7e1c6f063f8286e20a8d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/4d9d3634c27b2dfba4722b9e068f410ab17b8acd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lightracer Spark" V1.1.0 Patch
notes.content:
Greetings to all Amenders, 

We have made some optimization updates and bug fixes for the current version. Details are as follows:

Content update:

- Added [Random Event] system, you can experience some small stories based on chance in the process of amending civilization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/444240a4c6fa0efa993fbc1a0f12113f5818ed78.jpg[/img]

- Added [General] interface, which contains Star child, Log and Briefing system, these contents will be gradually unlocked as the Amendment progresses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/5667d74d953e29f35d48f2563828822cbb0b1ec2.jpg[/img]

- Added the "SKIP" function in multiple rounds of play. After clearing an ending of any planet, replay the story of this planet to enable the "SKIP" function, speeding up the text you have read.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/f43bb377c0550e1c28d877db637995897cf5e77d.jpg[/img]

- Modified the terrain illustration of the jurisdiction.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed the error of "District-Riosi" slot type
- Fixed "District-Driatov" special slot has no designated building
- Fixed the problem that the building - Intelligence Institute could not be unlocked
- Optimized the loading process to reduce crashes caused by initialization lag
- Optimized the subdivision of the map grid surface to reduce the crash caused by game lag
- The ending CG is adjusted to be triggered after the mission is over, to avoid the situation where the ending CG starts without finishing reading the text.
- Fixed the bug that new missions can be opened in the guide panel in the mission (If there is no feedback when clicking the [Access to Probe Link] event in Fusion Star, it may be caused by this bug, which has been fixed now. Please return to the main menu, click on the chapter node to select Fusion Star, and replay this task to play the subsequent content normally)

Greetings to all Amenders, 

We have made some optimization updates for the current version. Details are as follows:

Optimized content:
- Map drawing optimization
Re-adjusted the drawing density of the map grid to improve the non-display and stuck phenomenon caused by insufficient subdivision

- District UI optimization

All jurisdictional buildings, space station modules, and celestial engineering components support dynamic consumption display, and only unsatisfied resources in the list will be displayed in red

notes.title: V1.25 Happy Chinese Lunar New Year "Lightracer Spark" free DEMO update
notes.content:
Amenders, long time no see. We have collected your feedback, and made a small update on the occasion of the Chinese New Year.

The update content is as follows:

·Added a section of the main story [HEROES OF THE BADLANDS] in the [ORIGINIUM] chapter, which mainly depicts the story of a pilot named Simon Zuider who changed his hometown after being inspired by the Amender.

·Added a billing system, now you can check your own monthly fixed income and expenditure

·Added the function of resetting the initial points

·Added the ability to customize role names

·Added shortcut keys such as ESC to exit full screen

·According to the feedback from the first demo version, the guidance logic of the prologue has been optimized

·Fixed the BUG of the black screen after choosing the Path of the Corrector

·Fixed the situation where some models got stuck on the story illustration screen after entering the game

·Adapted to some widescreen resolutions

·Fixed some UI garbled characters

·some systematic comprehensive optimization

*special note*
At present, the demo version is still in the continuous development stage, and the archive is not compatible with the subsequent version and the Final official version.
Players who have tried the DEMO before, need to restart the ORIGINIUM chapter in the [Chapter] interface of the main menu to play the new content.
If you want to quickly pass through the content you have already played, you can adjust the text playback speed in [Settings].
Thank you so much!

If you encounter problems in the game, or want to discuss the game content with more friends, welcome to join the official discord：https://discord.gg/SzvGbBcKuC

Wish all the amenders a happy Chinese lunar new year！
